description: Updates an existing workflows bulk replace request and queues it for reprocessing. Only temporary requests accept attribute changes, and `replacement_type` and `old_assignee_id` can never be changed. Submitting an unchanged request retries a replacement that previously reported errors.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the workflow bulk replace request.

202.description: Accepted - Bulk replace request updated successfully

400.description: Bad Request - Request is not temporary or validation failed

404.description: Not Found - Request does not exist

new_assignee_ids.description: IDs of the assignees that take over the old assignee's workflow assignments.

new_workflow_manager_id.description: ID of the assignee that takes over workflow manager roles held by the old assignee. Cannot be the old assignee.

start_date.description: Date the replacement takes effect. Required when `replacement_type` is `temporary`.

end_date.description: Date the replacement ends. Required when `replacement_type` is `temporary`, and must be today or later and on or after `start_date`.

modify_project_roles.description: Whether project role assignments are replaced in addition to workflow assignments.

project_ids.description: IDs of the projects the replacement is limited to. Empty applies the replacement to every project the old assignee can access.

tools.description: Tools the replacement is limited to. Empty applies the replacement to all enabled tools.

type.description: Workflow tool this replacement targets. Must be a tool enabled for bulk replace on the company.

sub_type.description: Subtype of the workflow tool. Required when `type` is `GenericToolItem`.
